sections.excerpt: USE OF PROCEEDS We will not receive any of the proceeds from the sale or other disposition of shares of our common stock held by the Selling Stockholders pursuant to this prospectus. We will receive nominal proceeds from the exercise of the Pre-Funded Warrants if such warrants are exercised for cash at the exercise price of $0.01 per share. We will bear the out-of-pocket costs, expenses and fees incurred in connection with the registration of shares of our common stock to be sold by the Selling Stockholders pursuant to this prospectus.
